about: For the lab only; never reaches a session. Planted problem, kind p12 (A plus or minus whose good direction is unclear): see research/user-lab/planted.md.

plants.problem: The cost comparison writes its differences as +1 ₪ and −58 ₪ (on a cost, so minus is good) right below a −43 ₪ that means less money (bad); the words "more" and "less" are gone.
